items.title: NBAA Business Aviation Convention & Exhibition (NBAA-BACE)
items.location: Las Vegas Convention Center, Las Vegas, NV
items.description: The most influential business aviation event of the year. Seminars, exhibits, and networking — many Colorado pilots make the trip annually.

items.title: Fall Carnival at Rocky Mountain Metropolitan Airport
items.location: Rocky Mountain Metropolitan Airport (KBJC), Broomfield, CO
items.description: Community fall carnival at BJC — open to pilots and the public. A great excuse to stop in at one of the Front Range's busiest GA airports.

items.title: Paint a Plane: Aerial Bootlegging & Barnstorming
items.description: Wings Over the Rockies Exploration of Flight hosts a creative aviation event where guests help paint an aircraft — this month themed around the barnstorming era.

items.title: 2026 Aviation Business Conference
items.description: Aviation business leaders, operators, and professionals gather in Denver. Great networking for Colorado's GA and commercial aviation community.

items.title: CPA Annual Membership Meeting 2026
items.location: Rocky Mountain Metro Airport (KBJC) — Flatirons Room, Broomfield, CO
items.description: The Colorado Pilots Association's annual gathering. Open to members and prospective members — a great way to connect with the broader Colorado GA community.

items.title: AOPA Aviation Career Expo
items.description: AOPA's debut career expo covering piloting, maintenance, ATC, and more. Meet recruiters, attend workshops, connect with flight schools — great for any pilot planning their next move.
